policies.text: A cancellation fee may apply after a rider is matched with a driver. Conditions and grace periods vary with location. A customer who believes the fee is incorrect can use the official cancellation-fee review process. Public information does not confirm whether a specific fee is valid or whether a refund has been issued.
policies.demo_reply: Cancellation fees can depend on the circumstances and location. If you believe yours was charged incorrectly, please use the cancellation-fee review option in Uber Help so the trip can be reviewed securely.

policies.text: The cited Uber Help page directs riders to Account, Trips, the past trip and Receipt to check whether a cancellation fee appears. A temporary authorization can differ from a completed trip charge. Details may vary by market; avoid promising that a charge will be reversed.
policies.demo_reply: Please check the receipt for the trip under Account and Trips in the app. If the cancellation fee appears incorrect, contact Uber Help from that trip. Please keep payment and trip identifiers private.
